name: Phosphorescent Blight
body:
School evocation [light]; Level druid .

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as faerie fire except that if an illuminated creature passes within 5 feet of a non-illuminated creature, they are also affected by the faerie fire effect for the spell’s remaining duration.
